title: Restoration Courtesy for Long-Standing Policyholders — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
Cardinal recognises the length of time a household has kept its certified policy when a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate is restored by a reinstatement filing. The restoration courtesy percentage follows the whole months from the certified Cardinal Personal Auto Policy's inception date to today.

## Courtesy schedule

| Whole months from the certified policy's inception date to today | Restoration courtesy percentage |
|---|---|
| 84 or more | 20 percent |
| At least 36 but fewer than 84 | 10 percent |
| Fewer than 36 | None |

Whole months are complete calendar months counted from the inception date shown on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record to today.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical dates)

| Inception date | Today | Whole months | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March 2019 | 9 March 2026 | 83 | 10 percent |
| 10 March 2019 | 10 March 2026 | 84 | 20 percent |
| 10 March 2023 | 9 March 2026 | 35 | None |
| 10 March 2023 | 10 March 2026 | 36 | 10 percent |

## Points of judgement

- **Which policy?** The certified policy — the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy the certificate certifies — and its inception date, not the start of the current term.
- **Equality.** Exactly 84 whole months earns 20 percent; exactly 36 earns 10 percent.
- **Policies under 36 months.** No restoration courtesy applies.
